name: en-sentence-v1
description: Sentence-level English generation from RU meaning triples. Stacks the glossary (RU->EN words), subject-verb agreement (the 3sg rule), and a constituent-order rule INDUCED from example sentences and stored on the field. Given role-tagged (subject, verb, object) triples it produces an ordered, agreeing English clause with a fixed determiner. Honest ceiling: generation from given roles, not parsing free Russian into roles; article selection is simplified to 'the'.
